datagov.prompt: Search data.gov.il (for example תאונות דרכים, אוכלוסייה ביישובים)
datagov.enable: Turn on government data? Lumen then sends search words and dataset ids to data.gov.il and the CBS when you ask, and never on its own.
datagov.confirm: Search data.gov.il for “{query}”? Only these words are sent, nothing from your notes.
datagov.confirmSeries: Fetch CBS series {id}? Only its id is sent to apis.cbs.gov.il.
datagov.confirmRefresh: Fetch this dataset again? Only its id is sent.
datagov.noTable: This dataset has no table Lumen can read (only files without a data API).
datagov.seriesPrompt: CBS series id (for example 120010, the Consumer Price Index)
datagov.personal: Some columns look like personal data ({columns}). The CBS licence forbids cross-matching data to identify people. Insert anyway?
datagov.noBlock: Put the cursor in a ```dataset block first.
datagov.unchanged: Nothing changed since the last snapshot. Switch to the new date anyway?
datagov.changes: Changes since the last snapshot. Switch the note to the new one?
datagov.badBlock: This dataset block is missing its source, id or snapshot.
datagov.missing: The snapshot {path} is not in this vault.
